# scrutari_route (Resource)

Routing rule that maps `(host, path_prefix)` to an upstream service. Tenant scope is derived from the authenticated API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    scrutari = {
      source = "scrutari-ai/scrutari"
    }
  }
}

provider "scrutari" {
  # api_key from SCRUTARI_API_KEY env var (recommended)
  # host from SCRUTARI_HOST env var (default: https://api.edge.scrutari.ai)
}

resource "scrutari_route" "billing" {
  host                 = "api.acme-corp.scrutari.ai"
  path_prefix          = "/billing"
  upstream_url         = "https://stripe-proxy.acme-corp.internal"
  strip_path_prefix    = true
  preserve_host_header = false
  auth_mode            = "required"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Public host the gateway listens on for this rule (e.g. `api.acme-corp.scrutari.ai`). Lower-cased server-side. Cannot be changed in place — re-homing a route is delete-then-create.
- `path_prefix` (String) Path prefix this rule matches (e.g. `/billing`). Use `/` as the catch-all.
- `upstream_url` (String) Upstream URL the gateway forwards matching traffic to. Must be `http(s)://...`.

### Optional

- `auth_mode` (String) Authentication mode for traffic on this route: `required` (default), `optional`, or `passthrough`. **Setting to `passthrough` opens the route to anonymous traffic** — the gateway's audit log records this at WARN severity.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether this route is active. Inactive routes don't match traffic but still occupy a plan-cap slot. Defaults to `true`.
- `preserve_host_header` (Boolean) If true, the original `Host` header is forwarded to the upstream; otherwise the upstream's host is used. Defaults to `false`.
- `strip_path_prefix` (Boolean) If true, the matched `path_prefix` is stripped from the request path before forwarding to the upstream. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when this route was created.
- `id` (Number) Route ID assigned by the gateway. Stable across the row's lifetime.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID that owns this route, derived from the authenticated API key. Read-only.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent update.
